## Description

REFERRAL: to clinician/facility (free text or directory), urgency, reason, attached summary, channel (print, email, patient carries), consent for sharing, state (draft → sent → appointment booked → report received → closed). Incoming referral letters are filed as documents linked to a referral-in.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Sending a referral requires sharing consent where the policy demands it and records channel and time.
- [ ] **AC2.** Referral letter PDF includes only the selected summary content.
- [ ] **AC3.** Status can be updated with evidence (e.g. report received → document link).
- [ ] **AC4.** Open referrals are visible on Patient 360.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
